description: This file seeds the database with initial roles, skills, role-skill mappings, and sample progress data for the career pathway navigator backend. It defines functions to create or update roles and skills, attach skills to roles with levels, add recommendations, and ensure idempotency for repeated seedings.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Represents a skill entity in the database.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a role entity in the database.

methods.name: List[Skill] _ensure_skills(skill_repo: SkillRepository, specs: List[Tuple[str, str, str]])
methods.description: Creates new skills or fetches existing ones by name, enriching missing category or description fields.

methods.name: None _attach_role_skills( role_repo: RoleRepository, rec_repo: RecommendationRepository, role_name: str, role_skill_levels: Dict[str, int], target_role_levels: Dict[str, int] | None = None, )
methods.description: Attaches skills to a role with specified levels, updates required levels, adds optional recommendations, and computes gap annotations to ensure at least three gap skills per role.

methods.name: None seed_minimal_dataset(session: Session)
methods.description: Seeds the database with core roles, extended roles, skills, role-skill mappings, and baseline progress data.

methods.name: None seed_minimal_dataset_idempotent(session: Session)
methods.description: Performs an idempotent seed, ensuring all roles, skills, and mappings exist without duplication.
